description: This file defines a worker for handling batch database migrations within a clustered Mattermost server environment. It includes interface definitions, worker creation, batch processing logic, cluster synchronization checks, and migration completion marking.

classes.name: BatchMigrationWorker
classes.description: A worker that processes batch database migrations, ensuring cluster synchronization and marking completion.

classes.name: BatchMigrationWorkerAppIFace
classes.description: Interface for obtaining cluster status information.

methods.name: MakeBatchMigrationWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a BatchMigrationWorker with specified parameters.

methods.name: doBatch
methods.description: Performs a migration batch, checks cluster sync, updates job data, and handles completion or errors.

methods.name: checkIsClusterInSync
methods.description: Checks if all nodes in the cluster are running the same schema version.

methods.name: markAsComplete
methods.description: Marks the migration as complete in the system store to prevent reruns.
